entries.question: 3. If A = {p,q,r,s}, B = {m,n,q,s,t} and C = {m,n,p,q,s}, then verify the associative property of union of sets.
steps: Write A = {p, q, r, s}, B = {m, n, q, s, t}, and C = {m, n, p, q, s}. Union lists each distinct element once.
First A ∪ B = {m, n, p, q, r, s, t}. Therefore (A ∪ B) ∪ C = {m, n, p, q, r, s, t}, because every member of C is already present.
Independently, B ∪ C = {m, n, p, q, s, t}. Then A ∪ (B ∪ C) = {m, n, p, q, r, s, t}, adding r from A.
Both groupings produce exactly the same seven-element set. Thus (A ∪ B) ∪ C = A ∪ (B ∪ C), verifying associativity of union.
entries.answer: (A ∪ B) ∪ C = A ∪ (B ∪ C) = {m, n, p, q, r, s, t}.
